SELECT 
    s.station_name,
    w."waterLevelPct",
    w."waterPress_kpa",
    w."waterTempC",
    w."waterQualityIdx",
    w."wasteTankPct",
    CASE

        WHEN w."waterQualityIdx" >= 71 AND w."waterQualityIdx" < 91 THEN 'Good'
        WHEN w."waterQualityIdx" >= 51 AND w."waterQualityIdx" < 71 THEN 'Moderate'

        ELSE 'Unsafe'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "WaterAndWaste" w 
WHERE w."waterQualityIdx" >= 51 AND w."waterQualityIdx" < 71;

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
    SELECT s.station_name, w."waterQualityIdx",
        CASE 
            WHEN w."waterQualityIdx" >= 91 THEN 'High-Quality'
            WHEN w."waterQualityIdx" >= 71 AND w."waterQualityIdx" < 91 THEN 'Good'
            WHEN w."waterQualityIdx" >= 51 AND w."waterQualityIdx" < 71 THEN 'Moderate'
            WHEN w."waterQualityIdx" >= 26 AND w."waterQualityIdx" < 51 THEN 'Poor'
            ELSE 'Unsafe'
        END AS quality_category
    FROM "StationEquipmentType" s
    JOIN "Equipment" e ON e."EquipType" = s.equip_type
    JOIN "WaterAndWaste" w ON w."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE"
    GROUP BY s.station_name, w."waterQualityIdx",
        CASE 
            WHEN w."waterQualityIdx" >= 91 THEN 'High-Quality'
            WHEN w."waterQualityIdx" >= 71 AND w."waterQualityIdx" < 91 THEN 'Good'
            WHEN w."waterQualityIdx" >= 51 AND w."waterQualityIdx" < 71 THEN 'Moderate'
            WHEN w."waterQualityIdx" >= 26 AND w."waterQualityIdx" < 51 THEN 'Poor'
            ELSE 'Unsafe'
        END
) t;

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "WaterAndWaste" w 
JOIN "Equipment" e ON e."EQUIP_CODE" = w."equipRef"
WHERE e."EquipType" NOT IN ('Communication')
AND w."waterQualityIdx" >= 26;

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "Location" l
LEFT JOIN "StationEquipmentType" s ON s.station_name = l."STATION_name"
LEFT JOIN "Equipment" e ON e."EquipType" = s.equip_type
LEFT JOIN "WaterAndWaste" w ON w."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE";

WITH station_water AS (
    SELECT s.station_name, w."waterQualityIdx", w."waterLevelPct"
    FROM "StationEquipmentType" s
    JOIN "Equipment" e ON e."EquipType" = s.equip_type
    JOIN "WaterAndWaste" w ON w."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE"
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM station_water;

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.station_name,
        CASE 
            WHEN w."waterQualityIdx" >= 91 THEN 'High-Quality'
            WHEN w."waterQualityIdx" >= 71 AND w."waterQualityIdx" < 91 THEN 'Good'

    JOIN "Equipment" e ON e."EquipType" = s.equip_type
    JOIN "WaterAndWaste" w ON w."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE"
